entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer supporting multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine provides sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount for high-volume token processing. It features a custom vector graph engine and automated fact extraction, supported by connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain serves as an opinionated agent brain that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports scoped access for multi-user team environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agent memory that learns over time. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers clients for Python, Node.js, Go, and CLI environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that offers hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It provides a FastAPI server and supports both Python and TypeScript SDKs for managed or self-hosted deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system for sub-100ms performance and includes a React/Ink-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a dedicated Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory and structured facts. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that uses outcome-gated promotion for context bundles and playbooks. It integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints to help agents succeed on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a SQLite-backed message store with full-text search metadata. it builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing messages.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Discord, GitHub, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable memory locally for multi-agent systems. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and specialized plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to maximize prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a durable, file-based long-term memory solution that avoids vector databases in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. The project includes a dedicated Hermes adapter as part of its five-package plugin family.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It supports embedded in-process operation and features recency ranking, contradiction tracking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel for Hermes by consolidating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single stack. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs to populate a local cache. Built for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, it uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables cross-project memory for coding agents by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to avoid opaque databases.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files like AGENTS.md before the context window opens. This local-first MCP server aims to reduce prompt tokens by 94% using SQLite-backed durable memory.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that tracks durable Markdown context files for coding agents. It provides a shared lifecycle core for managing session handoffs and includes a migration workflow for importing project data.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for managing state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across ten chain families, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services autonomously with minimal code integration.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local Markdown files, cron jobs, and MCP configurations to provide capability routing for Hermes. It registers five specific tools for artifact retrieval and can automatically generate tool-routing notes using model calls.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted search. It supports advanced retrieval techniques including configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and HTTP daemon execution modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term data securely.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Designed for private repository management, this plugin adds deterministic slash commands for semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also includes automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation tool that uses a Git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memories without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to enable autonomous task execution for coding harnesses like Hermes. It enforces strict software development methodologies, including red-green-refactor TDD and YAGNI principles, to ensure high-quality code generation.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and desktop prototypes through coding-agent CLI support. It allows Hermes Agent to function within a design and prototyping workflow across macOS and Windows desktop applications.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security knowledge base for agents.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee functions as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. By combining vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning, it enables agents to perform complex searches using Python, Rust, or TypeScript clients.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It features 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and escrow payments. It includes a master router and a verification layer to handle dispute resolution between autonomous agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It utilizes a 112-entry word replacement table and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw automates the collective evolution of agentic skills by performing deduplication and quality improvements across sessions. It synchronizes skill libraries across multiple devices and team environments, integrating with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local directory for agentskills.io-compatible agents. The skills are available as spec-conformant plugins that work natively with Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This repository contains 1,153 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for other assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: These skills allow Hermes Agent to perform YouTube video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists. The integration requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple coding environments like Windsurf and OpenClaw.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills by watching active workflows. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts and thinking instructions tailored to specific tasks. It includes pre-built domain-specific lenses and provides reports that highlight both findings and potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for Pydantic AI through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project scales and includes a spec review gate that uses PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by combining prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically synchronizes edits from source files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards to facilitate a plan-approve-execute workflow.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded agent work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills allow Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts using the Agent Skills specification. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources in Portuguese. All skills follow the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This repository provides official integration for FLUX image and video generation, including prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 models. It contains API documentation, code examples, and a suite of six specialized video generation skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts existing repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It supports Node.js and Python environments while providing provenance through file and line number citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, and supports commercial transactions via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a local-first workflow language that uses a four-verb YAML specification to manage AI models and tools. It audits workflows for costs and permissions before execution and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading system to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token usage and includes graceful degradation if specific dependencies or models are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and exploits, followed by sandbox execution to verify findings. It incorporates a deterministic pre-scan using tools like Semgrep, Bandit, and ESLint to triage vulnerabilities.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI and Discord, supporting 97 languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% while evaluating prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for grounded execution. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple languages including Rust and Go, featuring a tiered application process with a final approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern uses SKILL.md files to facilitate progressive disclosure of agent capabilities. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on real-world CVEs. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to support comprehensive security workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright scripts. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language descriptions while ensuring they remain compliant with current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report any drift from official runtime profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project provides a CLI and MCP server to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides functional quality certification by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool automatically identifies and verifies project-compatible Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payment routed to the winning wallet upon human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local OCR for PDFs and images to maintain privacy alongside video-to-text transcription capabilities. It also features an e-commerce studio for batch material generation with brand overlays and AI-driven text refinement.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It is designed to provide structured web data across 31 platforms for agents including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, to ensure reproducible environments. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to maintain parity with upstream releases.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and utilizes Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool provides a one-line Termux command to install Hermes Agent on Android devices with support for over 200 AI models. It features a built-in gateway service to manage incoming connections directly from the mobile environment.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both standard deployments and operator-ready workflows, including configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH) platforms. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a Docker-based sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of Hermes using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative deployment of Hermes Agent, including configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix or systemd EnvironmentFiles for secure secrets handling.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes and OpenClaw agents across Docker and Kubernetes clusters. It tracks per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps while providing access through REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It facilitates hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs without a graphical interface.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from USB drives or external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers to deploy specialized agents for technical, sentiment, news, fundamental, and analysis tasks. It features a researcher team that assesses insights through structured debates.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other frameworks through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, scheduling, and monitoring spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web dashboard for managing parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It utilizes git worktrees for management and offers optional Docker or Podman sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture governed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features an MCP server for integration and automatically synchronizes the index whenever file changes occur.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption and associated costs across various AI coding agents, including Hermes. It offers a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit their usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed debugging of agent interactions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and any provider that supports markdown or general prompting.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLIs directly. It supports multi-device synchronization, allowing users to monitor session details and account limits across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports human-readable identity handles and facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for platforms like VS Code and Slack using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports multiple frameworks, including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during CLI workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that automatically switch between default and project-specific configurations based on the current folder. It enables the use of project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions to maintain context-specific agent behavior.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on agent configurations and tool descriptions without requiring API calls. It identifies issues like vague descriptions or missing stop conditions and supports SARIF and JSON outputs for CI/CD integration.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by monitoring local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally without API keys, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes-startup functions as a local-first skill that utilizes dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue. The tool prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for handling configurations across multiple CLI tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It serves as an all-in-one desktop controller for Windows, macOS, and Linux users.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application that integrates external agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while offering remote access via WebUI and Telegram. It distinguishes itself with built-in assistants capable of generating editable office documents such as PPT, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface runs the Hermes agent in-process and features a three-panel layout with an integrated workspace file browser. It is designed for both desktop and mobile use, utilizing secure SSH tunneling for remote accessibility.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive web dashboard that supports visual workflow building, Kanban boards, and scheduled jobs. It offers extensive connectivity, managing usage analytics and communication across ten platform channels including Slack, WhatsApp, and Discord.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It includes specialized tools for the Hermes ecosystem, such as a memory browser, an MCP catalog, and a Monaco-based file editor.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen different ACP-compatible agents into a single desktop or self-hosted environment. It is optimized for unattended code reviews by executing concurrent tasks within isolated git worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native macOS workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts, featuring an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access. It organizes agent activity through native views for Kanban boards, skills management, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering alongside dedicated modules for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges the active browser context with local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting and an opt-in controller that allows the agent to perform approved actions within browser tabs.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application designed specifically for iOS 18+ to drive self-hosted Hermes agents from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to provide mobile management of agent tasks, skills, and read-only memory analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines like OpenClaw, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking performance metrics like token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal, real-time tool call visualization, and system metrics to monitor the health of the Hermes AI agent stack.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live quota burn and analytics for 13 different agent sources without remote data uploads. It functions as a local cockpit for searching transcripts and browsing images generated during coding-agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to provide a specialized interface for remote cloud computers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, focuses on session management and task organization through an integrated kanban board. Users can manage profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets within a terminal-based environment.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports spawning up to five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 for secure Telegram authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes Agent with local or cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside support for ComfyUI and TTS.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It offers dedicated management tools for tracking tasks, configuring cron jobs, and overseeing MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity logs and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories while maintaining read-only access to environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual store for one-click skill installations. The interface supports model switching and streaming SSE responses for multi-agent workflows.
